t: This is the former Granville Theatre of Varieties in Walham Green, which has served as both a theatre and a cinema. It was designed by Frank Matcham, one of Britain's great theatre architects. Over a forty-year career he designed more than ninety theatres and reworked around eighty more. In London his work includes the Hippodrome, Hackney Empire, Shepherd's Bush Empire, the Coliseum and the Palladium. So the Granville belongs to a remarkable body of music hall and variety buildings, and it is worth looking up at it with that in mind.
